description: This Java class, JwtService, handles creation and validation of JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for security purposes within a Spring Boot application. It manages token generation, parsing, validation, and secret key handling using the io.jsonwebtoken (JJWT) library.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating and validating JWTs for authentication.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT for a given UserDetails object, encoding username and roles, with expiration based on configuration.

methods.name: extractUsername
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) from a given JWT.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Validates the token by checking the username matches and token is not expired.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the secret key used for signing the JWTs, based on the configured secret.

methods.name: isTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired based on its expiration claim.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the JWT token and returns the claims, verifying the signature.
